subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD/builtin search, MEMORY.md promotion, memory-lancedb, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the gap, but source authority, schema shape, merge/edit semantics, and cross-plugin ownership are product/API decisions rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, source-required promotion, and retrieval/review attribution before coding.

options.title: Settle Schema First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 to decide the canonical record and revision model first, then layer provenance on that schema.

options.title: Keep Provenance Wiki-Only For Now
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active-memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for the moment.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, source-required promotion, and retrieval/review attribution before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and Memory Wiki provenance history makes this the best available decision owner from the routing candidates.
